## Details

<a id="note_freq_lo"></a>
### [`note_freq_lo`](../../../../src/music/music_frequency_table.asm#L9) `$E200-$E253`

*data*

Note frequency table, low bytes (84 notes). Shared by the music player and the three effect players. Index n is the SID frequency of the note n semitones above B0, tuned for an NTSC C64 (1.0227 MHz): index 1 = C1 (32.7 Hz), 13 = C2, 58 = A5 (880 Hz), 83 = A#7. On a PAL C64 every note sounds about 2/3 of a semitone lower. The music player uses index 0 as a rest; the effect players play it as B0.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note), [`sfx_voice1_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice1.md#sfx_voice1_read_note), [`sfx_voice2_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice2.md#sfx_voice2_read_note), [`sfx_voice3_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice3.md#sfx_voice3_read_note)

<a id="note_freq_hi"></a>
### [`note_freq_hi`](../../../../src/music/music_frequency_table.asm#L22) `$E254-$E2A7`

*data*

Note frequency table, high bytes (84 notes), same index as note_freq_lo.

- **Read by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state), [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note), [`sfx_voice1_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice1.md#sfx_voice1_read_note), [`sfx_voice2_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice2.md#sfx_voice2_read_note), [`sfx_voice3_read_note`](../sfx/sfx_voice3.md#sfx_voice3_read_note)

<a id="music_voice_init"></a>
### [`music_voice_init`](../../../../src/music/music_frequency_table.asm#L37) `$E2A8-$E2D5`

*data*

Reset template for the music voice state $E100-$E12D (46 bytes), copied by music_reset_state: transpose 0; tie 0,0,0; ticks 0,0,0; end tick $FF x3; gate ticks 7 x3; end reload $FF x3; AD $11 x3; SR $97 x3; control $21 (sawtooth, gate) x3; articulation 0 x3; envelopes of instrument 0 x3.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state)

<a id="music_cmd_offsets"></a>
### [`music_cmd_offsets`](../../../../src/music/music_frequency_table.asm#L47) `$E2D6-$E2E6`

*data*

Branch offsets into music_cmd_jumps, indexed by bits 4-6 of a command byte (entries 0-7: $8x length, $9x volume, $Ax voice option, $Bx instrument, $Cx pulse width, $Dx filter, $Ex tempo, $Fx length). Entries 8-16 continue the series and are never used.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_long_lengths"></a>
### [`music_long_lengths`](../../../../src/music/music_frequency_table.asm#L51) `$E2E7`

*variable*

0 = normal length table, 1 = doubled lengths (commands $AC/$AD)

- **Read by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)
